entry.title: MoonClaw Noetix simulation review task for First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
entry.summary: noetix-e1-lab-01 review task links walk, link poses, static support, and Rabbita playback; 32/32 frames require static-support review, hardware authority moonmoon-safety-gate-only

primary_task.objective: Review the Noetix endless moon-walk simulation evidence as one MoonClaw work packet before any dynamic-stability or hardware-authority claim.

inputs.summary: Kinematic endless +x Noetix walk trace over Moonmoon terrain.
URDF-reference link-pose trace bound to the walk frames and contact probes.
Static COM/support report that explicitly remains review-only for dynamic walking.
Rabbita playback for inspecting the walk and link-pose skeleton.

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix walk json
artifacts.required_state: endless +x Noetix trace with lunar gravity, contact probes, and joint phases

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix poses json
artifacts.required_state: URDF-reference link poses are present for each Noetix walk frame
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 25 links per frame; status review-only

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix stability json
artifacts.required_state: static support evidence is reviewed before any dynamic-walk or hardware claim
artifacts.current_state: 32/32 frames require support review; worst planar margin -0.035 m; status static-support-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: static COM support is review-only until dynamic stability and controller evidence exist

artifacts.required_state: Rabbita renders Noetix walk, link-pose skeleton, frame controls, and simulation-only authority
artifacts.current_state: Noetix panel consumes walk and link-pose JSON with skeleton playback

acceptance_criteria.description: Task links walk, link poses, static support, and Rabbita playback evidence with concrete validation commands.
Static support review frames remain explicit blockers for dynamic walking evidence.
MoonRobo hardware_state remains HardwareDenied and authority remains moonmoon-safety-gate-only.
Task names dynamic stability/controller evidence as the next requirement before stronger simulation claims.

primary_task.safety_gate: Do not convert the Noetix walk trace, link poses, or static support report into hardware authority. Dynamic stability and controller evidence must be added before any claim beyond simulation review.
primary_task.next_action: Use this task to review contact, link-pose, and static-support evidence; then add dynamic stability/controller evidence or keep hardware denied.

source_walk.note: Kinematic endless-walk trace for MoonSuite collaboration: Moonmoon terrain plus Moonrobo Noetix model references. This is simulation evidence only, not hardware authority.

mass_model.source_status: simulation-assumption; no inertial tags in referenced URDF/profile

foot_geometry.source_status: simulation-assumption; URDF names link but omits sole collision geometry
simulation-assumption; URDF names link but omits sole collision geometry

profile.note: Mass, center of mass, foot sole geometry, and friction are explicit simulation assumptions until Moonrobo provides inertial/collision metadata.

source_static_support.note: Static support evidence only: dynamic walking can be valid with COM outside the instantaneous single-foot rectangle, but that requires a controller/dynamics model not yet present.

source_link_poses.note: URDF-reference link pose evidence for visualization and review: link names and nominal origins come from the Noetix URDF, feet are bound to Moonphys contact probes, and non-foot links are gait proxies until full URDF forward kinematics and inertial metadata are available. This is not hardware authority.
